title: refactor(rest): move registerSearchEndpoints into search-routes.ts (#23050 slice 9)
body:
Part of #23050
Clause-②: no

Slice 9 of the `rest-server.ts` split, by slice 1's pattern (landed note `6136102437`, steps 1–6), slice 2's getter refinement (`6189011700`) and slices 3–8's shape (PR #23670, PR #23705, PR #23719, PR #23729, PR #23763, PR #23882): the body of `RestServer#registerSearchEndpoints` (`GET {basePath}/search`, the cross-object search door onto the protocol's `searchAll`) moves to ONE new module, `packages/rest/src/search-routes.ts`. Routes, the ordered registrations, every handler's source digest, the published `dist/*.d.ts` and both bundles' export lists are byte-identical, and every reader whose reading included a moved line now reads it where it is, with its sum unchanged.

**No token of the body changed.** The body calls no class `static` (AST walk below), so the `static` exception (seat ruling `6205442867`) is not used. It reads no provider field either, so the seat's provider ruling (`6215084478`) does not apply: nothing in the host is a getter.

`rest-server.ts` goes from 10,047 to 9,995 lines (base `d5666be876`). The card stays open for the later slices; #23050 remains open after this PR.

## The pattern, applied

**Members the moved body reads**, from an AST walk of the method (TypeScript compiler API, symbol-resolved, base `d5666be876`): `registerSearchEndpoints` (JSDoc `:8993`, method `:8997`-`:9063`, body `:8998`-`:9062`, 65 lines).

| kind | member | reads | class declaration |
|---|---|---|---|
| field | `routeManager` | 1, the `register` call (`:8999`) | `:2024`, private |
| method | `resolveProtocol` | 1 (`:9005`) | `:2402`, private async |
| method | `resolveExecCtx` | 1 (`:9006`) | `:2870`, private async |
| method | `enforceAuth` | 1 (`:9007`) | `:2470`, private |

No bare `this`, no element access on `this`, no `this`-rebinding `function`, and no `RestServer.NAME` access (static reads: none). The seat's text count (the same four members, one read each) is confirmed.

**Control walk** (the same walker, same base, on the neighbouring methods): `resolveSecurityService` (`:8976`, just above) reads `kernelManager` ×2, `resolveRequestEnvironmentId` ×1 and `securityServiceProvider` ×2, which is what its source says; the `registerEmailEndpoints` stub (`:9084`, just below) reads `emailServiceProvider`, `enforceAuth`, `resolveExecCtx` and `routeManager` once each, slice 8's host literal.

**Module-level reads** (uses outside the method counted by the same walk):

- `GLOBAL_SEARCH_PARAMS` (`:661`, 0 other uses), `UNDECLARED_WHOLE_NUMBER_PARAM` (`:767`, 2) and `readDeclaredQueryNumber` (`:832`, 5): declared in `rest-server.ts` and **already exported** there; the module imports them from `./rest-server.js`. One declaration each, never a copy. No `export` was added anywhere.
- `refuseUnknownQueryParams` (`./query-allowlist.js`, 11 other uses), `refuseRepeatedQueryParams` (`./query-multiplicity.js`, 14), `mapDataError` and `logUnexpectedRouteError` (`./error-response.js`, 8 and 6): still used in `rest-server.ts`, so every import stays; the module imports the same names from the same modules. No import moved.

**Host shape (slice 1's shape B):** `SearchRouteHost` (4 members) lists exactly the members the body reads, each typed `RestServer['m']`. The class keeps the private method with its name, docblock and position; its body is now a host literal plus `registerSearchEndpoints.call(host, basePath)`. Methods go as late-bound closures, `(...a) => this.m(...a)`. The call site in `registerRoutes`' `registerForBase` (`this.registerSearchEndpoints(bp);`, `:4806`, under `api.enableSearch`) is unchanged.

**Fields, checked one by one:**

| field | read when | reassigned after registration? | handed over as |
|---|---|---|---|
| `routeManager` | registration only (one `register` call, a top-level statement of the body) | its one swap (`:5177` / `:5181` at base) wraps `registerMetadataEndpointsInner`, not this registrar | value |

No other field is read. The protocol the door searches is resolved per request by `resolveProtocol`, a method, so no getter is owed.

**Late binding, measured** (a one-off vitest file, copied in, run under the verify lock, deleted; not committed): a source `RestServer` registers its routes, the door is driven once, then `resolveProtocol`, `resolveExecCtx` and `enforceAuth` are replaced ON THE INSTANCE after `registerRoutes()` and the door is driven again.

- head: `MEASURE before: 200 {"hits":["early"]} | after: 200 {"hits":["late"]} | seen early:early-user,late:late-user | late enforceAuth calls 1`, `Tests 1 passed (1)`.
- ablation through `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`: the search host literal's `resolveProtocol: (...a) => this.resolveProtocol(...a),` replaced by `resolveProtocol: this.resolveProtocol.bind(this),` (a three-line anchor naming the literal; anchor 1 → 0, blob `1c7f7e45a921` → `507220e525a3`): `after` stays `{"hits":["early"]}`, `Tests 1 failed (1)`. Restored by the tool: blob `1c7f7e45a921` equals `HEAD`, `git diff HEAD` empty.
- base leg (base `rest-server.ts`, blob `2ba4159180`, restored into the tree under a trap, then `git checkout HEAD` with blob and diff proof): the same answers as the head, `Tests 1 passed (1)`.

## Proof of move-only

- **`.d.ts`:** `packages/rest/dist/index.d.ts` and `index.d.cts` built at base `d5666be876` (this worktree, before any edit), at the move commit `6a57870fe` and at the merge head `06bd4fcbc` are byte-identical: sha256 `7489de84bc6feccb7cb1f28bcbe4a97775324959c61c9bfc35e8a8c45a6f3bc9` for all, `cmp` silent. The head bundle carries a head-only marker (`registerSearchEndpoints.call`: 2 hits in `index.js`, 0 at base), so the declaration was rebuilt from the moved source, not replayed. `SearchRouteHost` and `search-routes` appear 0 times in the `.d.ts`; `private registerSearchEndpoints;` is still there. `src/index.ts` is untouched.
- **Export lists:** the base and merge-head ESM and CJS bundles each load with 39 exports and one sorted export-name list (sha256 `b3246be6a1718700…` on all four). No search-module name is among them.
- **Routes:** a source `RestServer` on a recording mock server, with a protocol that answers every member, dumped under slice 7's seven configs (default; scoped-optional; scoped-required; every provider set; `enableDiscovery: false`; `enableOpenApi: false`; both off under scoped-optional) plus an eighth, `enableSearch: false` under scoped-optional. Each dump holds `getRoutes()` (functions as arity), the ordered server registration calls, a whitespace-free sha256 of every handler's source, and the source itself.
  - **32 of 32 dump files byte-identical**, base `d5666be876` vs merge head `06bd4fcbc` (`diff -r` exits 0). default 75 routes (1 search door), scoped-optional 150 (2), scoped-required 75 (1), every-provider-set equals default, discovery-off 73 (1), openapi-off 73 (1), both-off-scoped-optional 142 (2), search-off-scoped-optional 148 (0). A second base run was identical to the first.
  - Because no token changed, every handler digest is identical, the search door's included, with no mapping.
- **The handler digest can fail:** a positive control added one character to the moved handler (`'Search not supported by this protocol'` → `…protocol!'`, through `ablation-replace.mjs`; anchor 1 → 0, blob `7161079aedd6` → `d2a5eb7f70dd`). Routes and calls were unchanged in all eight configs, and the handler digests differed in exactly the search door of each mounted base (`GET /api/v1/search`, and `GET /api/v1/environments/:environmentId/search` where scoped), nothing else, and nothing under `enableSearch: false`. Restored, blob `7161079aedd6` equals `HEAD`.
- **Moved body:** base `rest-server.ts` lines 8998-9062, one 4-space indent removed, against `search-routes.ts` lines 74-138: `diff` exits 0 (65 lines). The body has no empty line, no trailing whitespace, and its one template literal (`${basePath}/search`) sits on one line; every other backtick in the range is in a line comment.
- **Moved-line accounting:** `git diff --color-moved=plain --color-moved-ws=allow-indentation-change` base → `6a57870fe` over the two files: all 65 deleted lines are detected as moved. `rest-server.ts` is +13 / −65 in the whole PR: the stub body (host literal plus `.call`, 11 lines in place of 65) and the module's import with its comment (+2).

## Readers re-pointed (sums unchanged, no gate loosened)

| `execctx-consumer-census.test.ts` | 62 sites = 23 + 9 + 5 + 7 + 8 + 1 + 5 + 2 + 1 + 1 | the search site is BARE and guarded on its next line, as before (46 bare / 16 caught unchanged). Mentions 117 → 121: the seam once (forwarder ×2 in `rest-server.ts`, interface member ×2 in the module); `rest-server.ts` 58 → 59. Forwarders 11 = (10 − 1) + 3 − 1; neither map gains an entry |
| `ui-view-route-identity.measurement.test.ts` / `ui-view-route-tenancy.measurement.test.ts` | `this.enforceAuth(` 58, `this.resolveExecCtx(` 73 over the list (57 / 72 before, +1 each for the search literal's forwarders); ownership guard 1 | length 9 → 10 |
| dogfood `authz-conformance.test.ts` (realtime tripwires) | 0 hits over the ten files | length 9 → 10 |
| dogfood `authz-probe-blind-spot.census.ts`, `rest-server.ts` row | 70 / 19 / 51 unchanged; `this.routeManager.register(` 63 = 21 + 9 + 5 + 7 + 8 + 1 + 6 + 4 + 1 + 1; `private register*Endpoints(` 16 | new control `search-routes.ts: this.routeManager.register(` 1; `registrar list length` 10; `enforceAuth` 100 → 104 re-anchored (the one call site moved and is counted in both readings; the four new occurrences are the seam once; no call site added); `populationRule` names the new module |

The module header names none of the three closures in prose, so no census that counts those spellings reads a comment as a seam (a second commit, `6a57870fe`, reworded the first draft's header for exactly that reason).

Readers outside the list:

- `scripts/check-route-envelope.mjs` (a gate's target paths, `domain:spec`): `search-routes.ts` is discovered by the `*-routes.ts` convention and declared `dialectOnly` with ratchet #9559, as the eight earlier modules are, at its measured `stringError 0` / `siblingCode 0`. Its one hand-built refusal, the 501 `{ code: 'NOT_IMPLEMENTED', message }`, has no `error` key, and its catch sends `mapDataError`'s computed body, so neither rule counts it. `rest-server.ts` stays 16 / 14, so the sums 16 + 13 + 8 + 1 + 0 + 0 + 0 + 0 + 1 + 0 = 39 and 14 + 15 + 8 + 9 + 4 + 1 + 0 + 0 + 3 + 0 = 54 are unchanged (the gate compares both counts exactly, in both directions). Its output differs from `origin/main` only by the new row (19 → 20 modules, 10 → 11 ratcheted). `--self-test` green.
- No new ADR anchor: the body cites no `ADR-NNNN Dk`, and `check-adr-anchors` output is identical at `origin/main` and head (1770 decision-letter citations).
- No platform-checklist anchor names the search registrar; `check:platform-checklist` output is identical at `origin/main` and head.

Each is green after the re-point.
